scientific_intent.scientific_task: All-to-all weighted tissue-solute source and previous-concentration interaction
scientific_intent.discretization: 512 structured points on an 8 cubed integer grid, two species, full 512 by 512 nonlocal sum each species
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: All 65536 Float32 outputs exact original native CPU and independent Float64 all-pairs oracle; includes 1024 written values and 64512 zero tails. Original tolerance 1e-2 is strengthened to exact dyadic-fixture equality.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: dim8, nnt512, capacity32768, species1/2, native supported step1, 100 repeated complete two-species operators
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 dyadic input and bounded sums are exactly representable here; arbitrary concentrations and coupling coefficients can accumulate rounding drift and are not certified by this fixture.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Nonlocal coupling of biological tissue source strengths and previous solute concentrations; no physiological parameter calibration or full tissue simulation claimed.
scientific_intent.description: Native comments identify tissue sources qt and previous solute levels ctprev. Each output gathers every point through distance-indexed coupling tables. The primary operator classification is linear algebra because this is an implicit dense linear map of two input fields, rather than a local stencil. Biological tissue transport is the application domain.
scientific_intent.provenance: Source comments and actual distance-indexed all-to-all equations in unchanged native main.cu. Biological task is source identified; further PDE or Green-function provenance is not inferred.
